caption: The drawing shows a metallic cylindrical container with a handle on its right side, colored in shades of gray and brown to give a weathered, rusted appearance. Attached to the front of the container is a rectangular pocket made from the same metal, extending vertically and open at the top. Inside the pocket, there is an object resembling a wooden-handled tool with a rounded top and a ribbed or grooved shaft, rendered in shades of light brown and beige. The background is a plain, off-white or light tan color, and there are no additional objects or elements in the composition. The artist's signature, "N. Amantea," appears in the lower right corner.
title: Shaving Mug
